newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: HEIDEMIJ AND DUTCH RAILWAY SIGN DEAL.
newsitem.headline: HEIDEMIJ AND DUTCH RAILWAY SIGN DEAL.

text.p: Dutch engineering consultancy Heidemij said on Tuesday it had reached an agreement in principle to take over BV Articon, one of Dutch Rail's (NS) two engineering firms.
Heidemij and NS hope to complete the deal within a few months.
Articon, which has a turnover of 50 million guilders and employs 400 people, specialises in rail infrastructure.
Heidemij said its main interest in Articon lay in the infrastructure and building activities which will complement the operation of Heidemij's Grabowsky & Poort unit.
No financial details of the deal were disclosed.
